Send the PDF report to [TEACHER EMAIL REDACTED IN PUBLIC COPY; SEE LOCAL ORIGINAL] no later than Nov. 29, 2026, indicating AC6761 in the subject of email.
Around 25-30 minutes group presentation, and each team member should participate.
Project Title: The AI-Powered Financial Analyst: A Comparative Analysis

Each group should select two listed firms in the same industry to compare (e.g., Coca-Cola vs. PepsiCo), and download the most recent annual reports for both firms for at least two years (No need to submit annual reports). The written report should include the following sections:
1. Company and Industry Overview: Briefly introduce two listed firms’ background and justify why the comparison is meaningful.

2. Comparative Quantitative Analysis (including charts/graphs): Use AI tools to extract and compare the two firm’s financial situation (e.g., profitability, liquidity, solvency, efficiency, and/or market perception).
3. Comparative Qualitative Analysis: Use AI tools to analyze and contrast the tone, sentiment, and content of key sections of the reports (e.g., MD&A, CEO Letter, Risk Factors).

4. Investment Recommendation: Provide a clear Buy/Hold/Sell recommendation for each firm, supported by a synthesis of the findings from sections 2 and 3. Each group should add their own critical thinking to the AI-generated draft.
5. Critical Evaluation of AI Methodology: ​​Discuss the limitations, potential biases, and any errors encountered while using the AI tools.
